methods.captureAuditResult: 2539-2565: optional resultRef, no execution state captured

optional.admittedAt: safe nonnegative integer >= createdAt; required when state is dispatch_intent; public assertExecutionCurrent stores it
optional.resultRef: 64 lowercase hexadecimal; if present equals executionRef; public captureAuditResult stores it
optional.reportRef: 64 lowercase hexadecimal; requires resultRef; public submitAuditResult stores it
optional.outcomeEvidenceRef: 64 lowercase hexadecimal; required for completed/failed/terminated. Public settleAction stores input evidenceRef.
optional.terminalEvidenceRef: null or 64 lowercase hexadecimal for unknown; required non-null reference for completed/failed/terminated. Public settleAction copies actual worker terminalEvidenceRef; original worker starts null.

snapshotRows.unrelatedExecutionKind: ignored; only audit_input rows for exact retained claim are candidates
snapshotRows.terminalEvidenceInvariant: completed/failed/terminated require non-null actual stored terminalEvidenceRef and outcomeEvidenceRef; unknown allows absent or nullable terminalEvidenceRef as source stores it. Cancelled is not a public audit execution transition.
